content:
**Adorn** 是一款装饰和家具模组，添加了众多装饰方块，例如…… - **椅子和沙发！** 你可以坐在上面休息放松。沙发也是午睡的好去处。 - **抽屉！** 比箱子更小的容器，但是一件更精致的家具。 - **石火把！** 由石头制成，是比木火把更好的光源。 - **厨房方块！** 你可以用厨房柜台、橱柜和水槽来装饰你的厨房（非常适合包含 Kitchen Sink 模组的整合包！）。 - **还有更多：** 桌子、架子、栅栏、烟囱…… ## 依赖要求 ### Fabric

### NeoForge *无特殊要求。* ### Quilt - [Quilted Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl) ![](https://i.imgur.com/owM5tUa.png) ## 模组兼容性 Adorn 包含对以下模组的特殊支持： 模组 | Fabric 和 Quilt | Forge 和 NeoForge | 功能 -|-|-|- [Architect's Palette][arpal] | ❌ | ✅ | 方块变体 [Biome Makeover][bmake] | ✅ | ✅ | 方块变体 [Biomes O' Plenty][bop] | ✅ | ✅ | 方块变体 [Blockus][blockus] | ✅ | ❌ | 方块变体 [BYG][byg] | ✅ | ✅ | 方块变体 [Cinderscapes][cind] | ✅ | ❌ | 方块变体 [DashLoader][dashl] | ✅ | ❌ | 支持 Adorn 的方块状态 [Ecologics][ecol] | ❌ | ✅ | 方块变体 [EMI][emi] | ✅ | ✅ | 自定义配方功能等 [JEI][jei] | ✅ | ✅ | 自定义配方功能等 [LambDynamicLights][ldl] | ✅ | ❌ | Adorn 方块的动态光照 [Lil Tater Reloaded][ltr] | ✅ | ❌ | 土豆供电 [Mod Menu][modm] | ✅ | ❌ | 设置界面 [Promenade][promenade] | ✅ | ❌ | 方块变体 [Roughly Enough Items (REI)][rei] | ✅ | ✅ | 自定义配方功能等 [Tech Reborn][tr] | ✅ | ❌ | 方块变体 [Terrestria][terr] | ✅ | ❌ | 方块变体 [Towelette][towel] | ✅ | ❌ | Adorn 方块的流体日志记录 [Traverse][trav] | ✅ | ❌ | 方块变体 [Woods and Mires][wam] | ✅ | ❌ | 方块变体 [arpal]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architects-palette [bmake]: https://modrinth.com/mod/biome-makeover [bop]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/biomes-o-plenty [blockus]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/blockus [byg]: https://modrinth.com/mod/biomesyougo [cind]: https://modrinth.com/mod/cinderscapes [dashl]: https://modrinth.com/mod/dashloader [ecol]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ecologics [emi]: https://modrinth.com/mod/emi [jei]: https://modrinth.com/mod/jei [ldl]: https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights [ltr]: https://modrinth.com/mod/ltr [modm]: https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu [promenade]: https://modrinth.com/mod/promenade [rei]: https://modrinth.com/mod/roughly-enough-items [tr]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/techreborn [terr]: https://modrinth.com/mod/terrestria [towel]: https://modrinth.com/mod/towelette [trav]: https://modrinth.com/mod/traverse [wam]: https://modrinth.com/mod/woods-and-mires
